shared_anchors: Michael Caruso, 67, suspended Palm Beach County Clerk
Same five felony charges: kidnapping, lewd or lascivious molestation, lewd or lascivious exhibition, luring or enticing a child, child abuse causing mental injury
Incidents during family cruise in August 2025
Victim disclosure and confrontation in December 2025
novel_facts: Bond set at $160,000 by Judge A. James Craner at pretrial hearing Friday August 28, 2026
Bond breakdown: $50,000 each for three charges, $5,000 each for two charges
Specific bond conditions: no contact with victim/witnesses, passport surrender, cannot return to Orange County except for court, firearms prohibition
Tracy Caruso (wife) present in court, prepared to pay bond
Tracy Caruso resigned Monday from Health District of Palm Beach County board and as vice chair of Palm Beach State College Board of Trustees
Caruso's name will remain on election ballot as no withdrawal received
material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Same criminal case against Michael Caruso with identical charges and victim. The incoming article reports a material new development: bond being set at $160,000 with specific conditions and his impending release, which occurred at a pretrial hearing on August 28. This is a significant procedural advancement in the criminal case that readers need to know. Also includes new information about his wife's resignations and election status. This should update the existing canonical rather than create a new story.
